t: A description that stayed with people
a: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
p: Maraja-l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān, baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyān…
m: He released the two seas, meeting [one another]; Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses. So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
